focus.name: actor-collision-response-family
focus.purpose: Promote compact actor-collision cleanup, staged-response, and response-pair dispatch entries to behavior-based canonical names.

contracts.type02_08_09: clear source actor and owned resources, then run Actor_HandleType2DInteraction on the receiver
contracts.type23: clear source actor and owned resources, then enter the Type-0x23 response-pair allocator at 0x001ABFFA
contracts.type10: run the Type-0x10 staged response, decrementing its phase with ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE10_COLLISION_RESPONSE and completing through the terminal Type-0x84 template
contracts.type2f: clear source actor and owned resources, then run Actor_HandleType2DInteraction without receiver replacement
